DIAGNOSIS READY: Rice Dander Dermatitis (Occupational Allergic Contact Dermatitis) with Secondary Symmetrical Peripheral Neuropathy.

The clinical picture of a chronic itchy rash on the upper body and face, combined with numbness in the palms, in a patient working with rice and livestock, is most consistent with an occupational allergic contact dermatitis, likely triggered by rice dander or animal dander.
